executive_summary: UnitedHealthcare contract expires March 31, 2025. You have strong leverage (72/100) due to documented contract violations worth $3.34M and your position as their #2 provider in Orlando. Market analysis shows you're being paid 18% below median rates, representing $8.2M annual gap. Recommended strategy: Lead with violation resolution, then pivot to rate increases.

key_points: Two active contract violations totaling $3.34M in documented damages
You are their #2 provider in Orlando market (18% of their network)
12,400 annual admits generating $523M in revenue for them

phase_1.name: Violation Resolution
actions: Request executive meeting to discuss resolution
phase_1.objective: Establish leverage and recover immediate damages

phase_2.name: Rate Negotiation
actions: Propose 15% rate increase across all service lines
Offer violation settlement as part of package
phase_2.objective: Secure rate increases using violation leverage

phase_3.name: Final Terms
phase_3.objective: Lock in improved terms before expiration

batna.description: Terminate contract and redirect patients to Humana MA plans
batna.feasibility: Moderate - would require patient communication and referral network adjustments
batna.financial_impact: Short-term revenue loss of ~$120M, offset by improved rates with other payers

talking_points: We've documented $3.34M in contract violations that we're prepared to pursue through regulatory channels
